models.description: Low-cost scoped implementation/review candidate; quality is not yet calibrated locally. Require regression tests and parent verification.
Bounded exploration, summaries and test triage. Prefer concrete evidence over speculative conclusions.
User-preferred for detailed investigation and bounded implementation. Require tests for changes.
Escalate interacting constraints, substantial changes and difficult debugging here. Verify conclusions and regression tests.
Cross-provider investigation or second opinion. Compare evidence and accepted outcomes, not confidence.
Demanding cross-provider review when medium is insufficient. Higher reasoning is not a correctness guarantee.
